description: Report bugs, data issues, or feedback. Actions: bug, data_issue, irrelevant, praise. Does not count toward your monthly searches.

action.description: Type of feedback. Use "bug" for errors, "data_issue" for stale/wrong data, "irrelevant" for poor results.

message.description: Describe the issue. For bugs, include the error message.

opportunity_id.description: ID of the opportunity being reported on (if applicable)

request_id.description: From error response - helps us trace the issue

search_query.description: The search query that produced the issue

severity.description: high = user blocked, medium = degraded experience, low = minor issue

name: report_feedback
title: Report Feedback
